conventions.N_D: N_nonzero/D_nonzero over the task's training rows are primary (paper p.143); full sizes recorded
conventions.costs: F60 without additive b; F61 as log10(M/(R N)) with R=1; log2 throughout; log m floored at 1 bit; constants and hidden polylogs dropped: orders of magnitude only
conventions.labels: +1 = lower CLASSES index (pairs) or the named class (one-vs-rest)
conventions.margins: test rows inf-norm rescaled over training-support columns; predictions unchanged
conventions.model: unweighted ridge, no intercept; uniform-sample QOS computes unweighted ridge, so one-vs-rest balanced accuracy may be poor; no weighted variant in this task
conventions.sigma_min: 0 because D_nonzero > N_nonzero (Eq. F50 counts zero eigenvalues of X^T X)
